description: Reschedule a maintenance window, rename it, change its monitors or status pages, or post a public update on it. The pages show the change; subscribers are not notified.

add_monitors.description: Monitors (mon_...), components (comp_...) or servers (agt_...) to add to the window.

add_status_pages.description: Status pages that should also announce the window.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the title or message is written in. Defaults to the language of the current title.

message.description: Public update posted on the window now, e.g. "The work is extended by 30 minutes." Earlier updates stay.

remove_monitors.description: Monitors, components or servers to take out of the window. At least one must remain.

remove_status_pages.description: Status pages that should stop announcing it.

title.description: New public title. Its translations in other languages are kept.

name: update_maintenance_window
title: Update maintenance
